note: Market recipe IDs and Wowhead spell IDs are different. All 102 source-verified mappings are checked by profession, product, and reagent lists. The last 11 use Wowhead Classic and Forever localized spell names; one recipe was renamed in Forever (Jar vs Flask), and the two multi-output recipes retain market output quantities corroborated by independent Forever recipe references. No assertion about learnability or in-game client coverage.
